narr: Scattered to numerous thunderstorms developed along the Laramie Range during the mid afternoon hours on 6/21. A couple of storms became strong to marginally severe, producing quarter sized hail and wind gusts up to 60 MPH to the south of Chugwater along the Platte and Laramie County line. Localized flash flooding was also observed.
ev: A trained weather spotter provided video of water rapidly flowing over roadways and into nearby ditches between 5 and 7 miles S of Chugwater.
lsr: Video from social media showing water rapidly flowing over road and into nearby ditches.
